newsitem.title: INDIA: India IPCL says LDPE plant to resume.
newsitem.headline: India IPCL says LDPE plant to resume.

text.p: Production was due to be resumed on Friday at one of Indian Petrochemicals Corporation Ltd's (IPCL) polyethyelene plants after a two-day stoppage, a company official said.
"Production is being restarted today," an IPCL spokesman told Reuters by telephone from the western city of Vadodara, where the plant is located.
He said a safety valve decomposed in one section of the linear low density polyethyele (LDPE) plant on June 3.
The problem has been rectified, the official said.
He said IPCL has two sections of 40,000 tonnes per year capacity each producing LDPE at the Vadodara works.
"Two days of stoppage won't affect our targets," he said.
"We can easily make up for it over the year."
State-run IPCL is one of India's leading petrochemical producers.
